mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habits (user_id, name, daily_times, timezone, start_date, end_date, status, source_message_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{dailyTimes}::jsonb, #{timezone}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{sourceMessageId}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_message_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM habits WHERE source_message_id = #{sourceMessageId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM habits WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{now}::date)
